name: stargus
title: Stargus
description: Stargus code-only PAX port; converted StarCraft assets stay on SD.
about: Development build. Stratagus-based Stargus port. Requires a separately converted game tree and prepared media/runtime.paxassets, media/menu.paxmenu, media/terrain.paxtile and media/stargus_intro.ogg. No game graphics, music or sound samples are linked into the PAX.
changelog: 0.2.1: include the shared PAX filesystem header and make Guichan widget cleanup idempotent; verified intro menu and clean exit on the AIO.
controls: Mouse or touch: select units and use the game menus
Hold Menu 3 s: return to the launcher

extract.instructions: HOST COMPUTER REQUIRED: Startool is not an ESP32-P4 program. On Linux, use your own StarCraft data and build/run the upstream startool extractor using the steps in pax-modules/upstream/retroesp32/GUS_GAME_RECIPES.md (Recipe 1). Then run python3 ~/code/pax/pax-recipe/tools/prepare_stargus_sd.py /path/to/converted-stargus-tree. Copy the complete prepared tree, including media/, to /sd/roms/stargus/. Recipe PAX only creates the SD folders and shows these instructions; it does not run startool. Graphics and sound remain as SD data, not in the store executable.
